meta.name: muapi-social-pack
meta.description: Re-render a hero image into Instagram, TikTok, YouTube-shorts and Twitter/X aspect ratios.

copy.tagline: 将主图重新渲染为各社交平台比例
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在多个平台发布统一视觉内容
copy.tagline_en: Re-render a hero image into social media aspect ratios
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to publish consistent visuals across multiple platforms

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能把一张主图重新裁剪成 Instagram、TikTok、YouTube Shorts 和 Twitter/X 等平台的常用比例，并保持主体居中、色调一致。
howto.when: 当你提到“社交包”、“调整尺寸”、“跨平台发布”等关键词，或要求把一张图适配多个社交平台时触发。

say.text: 把这张主图做成适合 Twitter 和 YouTube Shorts 的版本。
say.note: Claude 会按 16:9 和 9:16 分别处理。

say.text: 给这张图加上顶部留白，用于 Instagram 配文。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can re-crop a hero image into common aspect ratios for Instagram, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, and Twitter/X, keeping the subject centered and matching the original lighting and palette.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like "social pack", "resize for social", "cross-post", or ask to adapt an image for multiple social platforms.

say_en.text: Crop this image to Instagram 1:1 and TikTok 9:16.
say_en.note: Claude will generate two new images and return their asset IDs.

say_en.text: Make versions of this hero image for Twitter and YouTube Shorts.
say_en.note: Claude will process at 16:9 and 9:16 respectively.

say_en.text: Add top headroom to this image for an Instagram caption.
say_en.note: Provide a caption_idea; Claude will leave space at the top.
